note: Old name -> new name for batch 2D (navigation and layout). Library: package:charcoal_ui/next.dart; the admin pieces are in package:charcoal_ui/admin.dart.

members.ConsoleRow.titleStyle: removed; CharcoalListRow.titleMonospace covers the monospace case
members.ConsoleStatCard.valueStyle: removed; the value is always the section-title role

changes: ConsoleNavTile and CharcoalNavigationItem are one widget: the sidebar look is CharcoalNavigationItemVariant.sidebar (smaller corners, information-tone selection). Selection is a persistent layer painted directly from `selected`; hover and press are a separate transient layer.
ConsoleRow no longer needs a Material ancestor: it is built on CharcoalClickable and paints its state layer inside its own decoration. Row hover, focus, press and selection never change bounds.
CharcoalNavigationBar implements CharcoalContextualHeight, so CharcoalScaffold reserves the text-scale-aware height.
CharcoalPagination takes pageLabel (accessible name of a page button) in addition to previousLabel/nextLabel; CharcoalPagination.compact keeps both buttons in place and disables them at the ends.
ConsoleBatchBar's Chinese strings became parameters (selectLabel, cancelLabel, deleteLabel, selectedCountLabel) with English defaults.
Selectable text in rows and info tables uses a widgets-level SelectableRegion without platform handles.
Admin pieces (batch bar, info rows, meter, stat card, sidebar, admin shell) are exported from package:charcoal_ui/admin.dart, not next.dart.
